$comment: Plugins the Tauri build cannot run. "unavailable": no backend implementation on any platform; their menu and preload are left out of the page bundle (it imports main-process code). "unavailableOnMobile": desktop-only plugins (window, global shortcut, SOCKS relay and Discord features) that Android cannot use. Both are forced off and greyed out in the menu. Read by vite.config.mts and src-tauri/src/config.rs.
